explain.title: What entrepreneurship means
explain.body: Entrepreneurship is the process of starting a new business or organization. An entrepreneur identifies a need, develops an idea to meet it, and takes the risk of bringing that idea to life.

explain.body: Key characteristics refer to the essential traits or qualities that define a particular role or person. explain.title: A business plan is a roadmap
explain.body: A business plan is a detailed document that outlines your business goals and the strategies you will use to achieve them. It serves as a blueprint for your business, helping you to stay organized and focused. In simple terms, it sets out what the business wants to do and how it plans to do it.

explain.title: Research the market
explain.body: Market analysis involves researching your target market to understand the needs and preferences of your potential customers. This includes studying market trends, analyzing competitors, and identifying your target audience. For example, an online bookstore should find out what students want to read and what other sellers offer.

explain.title: Plan how income will be earned
explain.body: A revenue model outlines how your business will generate income. This includes pricing strategies, sales forecasts, and potential revenue streams. A business needs to plan income so it can decide what to sell and how to price it.

explain.title: Promote the business online
explain.body: Digital marketing strategies involve promoting your business online through various channels such as social media, search engines, and email marketing. Choose channels that can reach the intended customers.

explain.title: Test and improve the idea
explain.body: Prototyping involves creating a preliminary model of your product or service to test and refine your business idea. Iteration is the process of making improvements based on feedback. A prototype can be a simple sketch, digital model, or physical sample.

mistakes: Do not describe market analysis as only calculating income; it is research into customers, the target market, trends, and competitors.
Do not confuse a revenue model with a marketing strategy: the revenue model explains how income is earned, while marketing promotes the business.
Do not list digital channels without linking them to promotion of the business.
Do not call a prototype the finished product; it is a preliminary model used for testing.
When asked for a business plan, do not leave out any named part of the question, such as market analysis, revenue model, or digital marketing.

notes.title: Entrepreneurship and why it matters
notes.answer: Entrepreneurship is the process of starting a new business or organization. It can create jobs, support economic growth, and encourage innovation.
notes.explanation: An entrepreneur starts and runs a new business or organization. Entrepreneurs identify a need, develop an idea, and take a risk to make it real. Their businesses can create jobs, support economic growth, and bring new ideas and products.
notes.simple: An entrepreneur spots a need, thinks of a way to meet it, and starts a business—even though it might not succeed.
examples: A neighborhood bakery started to serve its community is a local example of entrepreneurship.
Facebook, Google, and Apple began as small tech companies founded by entrepreneurs with innovative ideas.
steps: Spot a need in the market.
Think of a product, process, or service that could meet that need.
Take the risk of starting a business or organization.
Run the business and create value for customers.
notes.checkQuestion: What is the origin and meaning of the word entrepreneur?
notes.checkAnswer: The word entrepreneur comes from a French word meaning “to undertake.” Entrepreneurs undertake the task of starting and running new businesses.

notes.title: Entrepreneurship in the Digital Landscape
notes.answer: Digital entrepreneurship uses internet-based tools and technologies to create and run businesses.
notes.explanation: Digital technologies help entrepreneurs operate businesses, connect with customers and sell products online. Tools such as social media, mobile apps, cloud computing, big data analytics and e-commerce platforms can help a business reach more people and work efficiently.
notes.simple: Digital entrepreneurship means using internet-based tools and services to start or run a business.
examples: A small clothing business can use Instagram to show products and answer customers’ questions.
A Pakistani business can use an e-commerce platform to list products, manage orders and sell to customers in different cities.
steps: Choose a product or service to sell.
Use digital channels to promote it and connect with customers.
Use an e-commerce platform to display products and manage online sales.
Use customer and sales information to make better business decisions.
notes.checkQuestion: What does an e-commerce platform help a business do?
notes.checkAnswer: An e-commerce platform lets a business sell goods online and can help it manage inventory, payments and customer service.

notes.title: Digital Tools and Platforms
notes.answer: Digital tools and platforms help businesses research markets, promote products, and sell online.
notes.explanation: Digital tools help people do tasks efficiently. For example, Google Docs lets users create and edit documents online and collaborate in real time. Market research tools help businesses learn about customers and competitors; online marketing tools help promote products; e-commerce platforms help sell products and manage payments and customer support.
notes.simple: These are online helpers for running a business: some help you learn about customers, some help you promote your business, and some help you sell online.
examples: Google Analytics tracks website traffic and user behavior.
Shopify helps a business create and manage an online store.
steps: Use market research tools to understand customers, competitors, and market trends.
Use online marketing tools to promote products through digital channels.
Use e-commerce platforms to set up online stores, manage payments, and support customers.

notes.answer: Identify what people need or want, then develop and test a solution using design thinking.
notes.explanation: Business ideas often begin by noticing what people need or want. Surveys, market research and observation help identify these needs. Design thinking then gives a five-step way to develop and test a solution.
notes.simple: Find out what people need, then use a creative process to make and test a solution.
examples: Observing that online shopping is popular in Pakistan can lead to ideas for e-commerce platforms suited to local preferences.
Students could develop an app that gives farmers in rural Pakistan weather forecasts and market prices.
steps: Identify a need or problem people have.
Use surveys and questionnaires, market research, or observation to understand it.
Use design thinking: empathize, define, ideate, prototype and test.
Gather feedback and improve the solution.

notes.title: Developing a Business Plan
notes.answer: A business plan sets out business goals and strategies, market analysis, a revenue model, and digital marketing strategies.
notes.explanation: A business plan is a detailed document that outlines your business goals and the strategies you will use to achieve them. It helps an entrepreneur understand customers and competitors, plan how the business will earn money, and decide how to promote and improve its product or service.
notes.simple: A business plan is a roadmap. It explains what a business wants to do and how it will do it.
examples: An online bookstore could research what students read, sell books through an online page, and promote special offers on social media.
A business could make a simple prototype of a product, collect customer feedback, and improve it.
steps: Set out the business goals and strategies.
Research the target market, customers, and competitors.
Plan how the business will earn income.
Choose online ways to promote the business.
Make a prototype and improve the idea using feedback.
notes.checkQuestion: What are two things an entrepreneur should include in a business plan?
notes.checkAnswer: Research customers and competitors, decide how the business will earn money, and plan how to promote it.

notes.answer: A business plan describes the market, customers, business strategies and ways the business will earn revenue.
notes.explanation: Entrepreneurship means starting a business or organisation and developing ideas into useful products or services. Digital tools help entrepreneurs understand customers, promote products and sell to people online. A business plan explains how a business will operate and earn income.
notes.simple: Find a real need, plan a useful solution, and use suitable tools to reach customers.
examples: A student can use an online survey to find out which books local students need, then sell those books through an online bookstore.
A farmer-focused business could use design thinking to learn farmers’ problems and test a simple service before launching it.
steps: Identify a customer need using research, surveys or observation.
Develop a useful idea and improve it by understanding the users.
Plan the market, income, costs and strategies in a business plan.
Use digital tools to promote and sell the product or service.
Consider how the business can support social, environmental and economic sustainability.

To prevent customers from accessing business services

Incorrect: cloud computing does not replace informed business decisions with guesses.

To limit a business to one local customer

Incorrect: social media can help a business reach customers beyond one local customer.

They make online customer service impossible
They only work when customers visit a physical office

Incorrect: mobile apps do not remove competition.
Incorrect: mobile apps can support customer convenience rather than making customer service impossible.
Incorrect: mobile apps can let customers use services on their smartphones without visiting an office.
